verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that vLLM has a CLI that starts an OpenAI-compatible server and accepts flags such as --trust-remote-code. Nothing in the pack documents command-line settings for GPU offload or context length. A model-serving CLI could clearly ship these options, so the axis applies, but the unrelated flags count only as adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line
